description: This file defines a Flutter StatefulWidget for an OTP verification screen, including UI layout and logic for OTP input, verification, and a debug bypass feature for testing. The widget handles user interaction, input validation, and navigation to the home activity upon successful OTP verification or bypass.

classes.name: OTPSecondScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget representing the OTP verification screen with input, UI elements, and testing bypass feature.

classes.name: _OTPSecondScreenState
classes.description: State class for OTPSecondScreen handling UI state, input, verification logic, and bypass mechanism.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the TextEditingController to free resources.

methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the OTP verification screen.

methods.description: Handles tap events on the continue button, including triple-tap bypass detection.

methods.name: _bypassOTPForTesting
methods.description: Performs a debug bypass of OTP verification, updates preferences, and navigates to HomeActivity.

methods.name: _verifyOTP
methods.description: Validates OTP input and simulates OTP verification process, then navigates to HomeActivity.
